staticFrame.alt: A night harbour drawn in vector. A narrow lit gate admits a few signals, while most points of light remain in the dark water outside it.

scenes.label: 01 / The narrow harbour
scenes.heading:
The sea doesn’t stop.
*The queue has to.*
scenes.narration: A story about the signals we can review, and the ones we miss. Scroll to enter the harbour.

scenes.label: 02 / Time moves one way
scenes.heading:
Only the past
can guide this light.
scenes.lead: Transactions arrive with history, not hindsight.
scenes.narration: Temporal and behavioural features use information available before the transaction. The frozen model returns a risk score. These moving lights are an illustration, not a transaction log.

scenes.label: 03 / The review gate
scenes.heading:
The harbour
has a capacity.
scenes.lead: A 0.5% alert budget is the project’s operating assumption.
scenes.narration: The highest-risk fraction enters review. The opening is a visual metaphor, not a score threshold scale or evidence of a real team’s staffing. A risk score is not a fraud verdict.
scenes.note:
Budget limits the queue.
It does not make the sea safe.

scenes.label: 04 / One evaluation
scenes.heading:
A bright signal.
A narrow reach.
scenes.narration: Precision describes the flagged set. Recall describes the fraud that was caught. At this budget, most fraud is missed. Read both numbers together.

scenes.label: 05 / Seven different tides
scenes.heading:
Now let
the days pass.
scenes.narration: Choose a recorded day. The dial moves through real daily precision, recall and alert counts. It does not simulate an untested threshold.

scenes.label: 06 / Two records, two questions
scenes.heading:
The second number
gets its own story.
scenes.narration: The replay recorded 75.22% precision and 12.13% recall. It is not the held-out test. The replay reports zero budget violations under its policy; daily alert counts use whole transactions.

scenes.label: 07 / Outside the light
scenes.heading:
Keep the darkness
in the picture.
scenes.narration: Each point here represents one fraudulent transaction counted in the replay. Positions are editorial. The 28 false positives are separate: 113 alerts included 85 true positives and 28 false positives.

scenes.label: 08 / A signal, not a verdict
scenes.heading:
Help someone
*look closer.*
scenes.lead: Prioritise a review. Leave the verdict to it.
scenes.narration: UPI Fraud Engine’s useful contract is a bounded queue with its trade-offs visible. Longer replay and real review feedback remain future work, not claimed operational impact.

audio.explanation: This world is a silent illustrated harbour. It has no audio asset and makes no audio request.
